commonProcedure.truth: Keep authoritative fact versions, their actual sources, private memory/belief versions, institutional records, divine-channel answers and conditional forecasts in different records. A software log is evidence, not a character sense or omniscient validation channel. Actual Director-established facts can be inputs without a database, but no invented source, lore, faction roster or missing formula is a positive witness. commonProcedure.audience: Director audit stores full evidence privately. Recipient data contains only legitimately disclosed payloads, their observation time and permitted provenance. No total queried event count, hidden IDs, gaps, negative roster certification or reasons for unavailable results. Independent readable records can give historical reports about a protected subject; never validate those through the protected current subject. No new spell grants sight, LoE, proficiency, faction membership, standing or command.
commonProcedure.defenses: Protection from Scrying is new-information protection about its actual subject, not blanket immunity to every Divination consequence. Seal Vision blocks actual Divination components at its exact operator/recipient/observation loci. No pending MD196/AG190/TF192/CC194 proposal supplies a defense or permission.

procedureContent.selection: NEW CA198-CENTER: choose a perceived point with LoE within120ft on the caster's current plane. At surviving cast resolution freeze a closed three-dimensional52800ft-radius region about that point; boundaries inclusive by actual occupied event extent. The center and timestamp never follow the caster. No cross-plane events or history/future/live feed. Ordinary walls, darkness, underground placement and concealment inside the region do not obstruct abstract knowledge; only selecting the center needs normal perception/LoE.
procedureContent.payload: NEW CA198-EVENT: all current finite mechanical/narrative occurrences, not a sample. The Director supplies a complete closed scene event partition: ongoing actor activities and environmental processes plus instantaneous changes resolving at the observation checkpoint, with event type, participating independently readable subjects, place/extent, start and current stage, actual cause/result when presently established. Include simultaneous concealed/indoor/distant events. Resolve concurrent events in source event order, with this snapshot after its own commitment/counter window. Microscopic repetitions belong to their containing physiological/material process; no atomic telemetry, future RNG or unstated secret thought/intent access. A private thought is not a world-observable occurrence in this NEW grain. Uttered/written language can be known as an occurrence with exact symbols, not automatically translated or made objectively true.
procedureContent.disclosure: Project that complete private partition through each fact's actual protection. Full content stays in audit; the delivered hierarchy has no hidden placeholders/counts or completeness flag that certifies protected absence. A direct query with no permitted fact returns only No information available. Independent fields of other events remain useful. Extent and object ownership alone do not bypass a ward protecting a subject.
procedureContent.retrieval: The full permitted finite snapshot is received instantly and retained without arbitrary clue cap. NEW a focused tactical search/retrieval consumes the caster's own Action; spontaneous recognition of an already retrieved fact is ordinary memory. Outside initiative an exhaustive search is an actual six-second focused activity, not a rest or research credit. Ordinary speech/sharing uses real communication/time; no free broadcast, targeting sight or retroactive result. Later movement changes the world, not the stored snapshot.
procedureContent.lifecycle: No concentration or ongoing parent after resolution. Counter/suppression before acquisition prevents payload. Repeated paid casts produce distinct snapshots; equivalent unchanged facts yield equivalent content, actual changes yield new timestamped versions. Caster death does not rewrite prior recipients' facts. Memory loss uses its exact accepted source.
